instruction: Mounting-Hole Pad Stack for Standoff Grounding The file board.kicad_pcb has 4 non-plated mounting holes (H1-H4). For this workflow, start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. The file /home/user/Desktop/analog_region.yaml defines the analog ground sub-region boundary (analog_midline_y_mm). The hole with the lowest Y coordinate that is below the analog midline must remain isolated (non-plated); the other 3 are converted to plated through-holes connected to GND. Convert 3 of the 4 mounting holes to plated GND connections. The plated holes must have drill=2.5 mm, an annular ring of 1 mm (pad diameter=4.5 mm), and thermal_bridge_width=0.4 mm. The isolated hole remains np_thru_hole with no net. Requirements: 1. Exactly 3 holes are thru_hole pads on net GND. 2. Exactly 1 hole remains np_thru_hole with no net. 3. The isolated hole is the one with the minimum Y coordinate among holes with Y < analog_midline_y_mm. 4. Plated hole pad size = 4.5 mm (diameter), drill = 2.5 mm (annular ring = 1 mm +/- 0.1 mm). 5. Plated holes have thermal_bridge_width = 0.4 mm. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
